title: Synthetic Data
summary: A Claude Code plugin that packages several synthetic-data skills — schema-based generation, real-to-synth fitting, PII replacement, LLM-driven persona generation, and quality/privacy evaluation — invoked on demand by the Claude agent. Its tabular-from-real skill fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and multi-table HMASynthesizer on real CSVs and samples synthetic tables, with SDMetrics used separately for fidelity/diagnostic reports.
evidence: skills/tabular-from-real/SKILL.md:35-88 shows GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, HMASynthesizer fit/sample calls via sdv.single_table/multi_table
needs: SKILL.md files are agent instructions/code templates rather than an executed application; actual runtime invocation depends on the Claude agent following them.
